plugins.name: user-hud
plugins.description: A control panel tucked into the corner above the Claude Code prompt: prompt-cache countdown with a 2-minute keep-warm alert (a macOS alert with a Keep warm button), model and effort pickers, quick settings, and handoff buttons (write one, read the newest).

plugins.name: pr-review-ui
plugins.description: PR reviews as numbered points in one standard format; the PR is checked out into a review worktree and each point's code opens beside the review with the changes highlighted: in your editor, in terminal-browser, or in a code pane.

plugins.name: ask
plugins.description: A side chat in a pane that reads the main chat, scrolls and draws: /ask a question, /draw a diagram. Nothing goes back to the main chat unless you send it. Answers are Mermaid drawn as box art in the terminal and as SVG in the desktop app.
